prompt: Rendered in the style of an oil painting, this wedding reception scene captures a lively moment. On the left, a man in a blue suit stands tall, holding a crystal flute filled with champagne. Next to him, a woman in a silver dress leans slightly forward, her hand resting gently on his arm as she looks at the flute. In the center foreground, a wooden chair sits empty, its carved back facing the viewer. Behind the chair, a bride in a white lace gown smiles warmly while looking at a small child in a yellow dress who is sitting on her lap. To the right of the bride, a groom in a black tuxedo points toward the dance floor with his right index finger. A golden retriever lies calmly next to the groom, its head resting on its paws. Near the dog, a waiter in a white apron hands a plate of cake to an elderly woman in a purple shawl. The elderly woman reaches out with both hands to accept the plate. In the background, a large floral arrangement with red roses stands on a pedestal. A musician in a green vest plays a violin near the flowers. A guest in a striped shirt watches the musician intently. Another guest in a polka dot dress dances alone near the edge of the frame. A spilled glass of wine stains the wooden floor near the dancing guest. A balloon floats above the crowd, tethered by a thin string. There is no smoke in the air. There is no digital clock on the wall.
